Name: Easy Standard Farm
Author: AlyaLyalya
Description:
UPDATE 1.1.0 - Fixed a bug. I had to move the spouse patio slightly because it was causing random glitches with spouse sprites. NOTICE: You can update the mod mid-save, and it shouldn't cause any issues. However, I still recommend a new save. I'm very sorry for the inconvenience.

[size=2]Hello everyone! This is my new farm. It is a replacement for STANDARD farm.[/size]
[size=2]
So, this map features: 
* Config Options
  - Different Starter Gifts - choose before starting new save file!
  - Layout (if TRUE - [/size][size=2]adds a planning layout for crop fields, sprinklers, fish ponds, ect)

Farming: All tiles should be tillable![/size]
[size=2]Foraging: Berry Bushes, respawning stumps, a little quarry. 
Ranching: start with the blue grass! [/size]
[size=2]Fishing: you can catch a mountain and a river fish on the farm.[/size]
[size=2]It's safe to pass out on your farm.[/size]

Starter Gift "Farming": Chest 1, Quality Fertilizer 15, Quality Sprinkler 2, Kale Seeds 15, Preserves Jar 1, Hashbrowns 3,
Starter Gift "Ranching": Chest 1, Hay 20, Parsnip Seeds 10, Bee House 1, Mayonnaise Machine 1, Hashbrowns 3,
Starter Gift "Mining": Chest 1, Glowstone Ring 1, Wood Mallet 1, Cherry Bomb 5, Geode 5, Cranberry Sauce 3,
Starter Gift" "Joja": Chest 1, Joja Cola 5, Lawn Flamingo 1, Fried Eel 3, Crystalarium 1.


[size=2]Compatibility:
Recolors - should work fine.
SVE - I don't play with it but warps to Woods, Forest and Railroad should work, also in SVE mod config you can choose 'Grandpa's Shed' option that moves the warp point off the farm and custom coorditanes for Enchanted Grove Warp. 
Minecarts - this map is shorter then standard vanilla farms and some mods that add minecart on the farm might cause an issue with black void after the right edge of the farm map. If you have it, try choose custom option in those mods if possible. I know that [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21859](CP) More Minecarts[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts - A Minecart Expansion[/url]﻿ have this option. So in configs of those mods choose (x 60 y 6 or whatever you want).[/size]
[size=2]make sure you don't have other mods replacing this farm[/size]

[size=2]!!! Make sure you don't have other mods replacing STANDARD farm !!![i] [/i][/size]

[size=2]Requirements:
 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿
 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

How to Install:
Download and then unzip
Put the unzipped folder into your mods folder
Run the game and pick the Standard Farm[/size]

[center][size=2][i]I wish you all the best.[/i][/size][/center]
